description: View and manage your OpenCode Go subscription right in VS Code: 5-hour/weekly/monthly usage bars, subscription status, available models, and multi-account support with one-click console access.
views.openCodeGo.title: OpenCode Go
views.dashboard.name: Subscription Dashboard
config.title: OpenCode Go
config.autoRefreshInterval: Auto-refresh interval in seconds. Set to 0 to disable.
config.gatewayUrl: Local relay gateway base URL (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8000). Leave empty to disable gateway integration.
config.notifyThresholds: Usage alert thresholds: warn/crit percentages and whether notifications are enabled.
config.notifyEnabled: Show VS Code notifications when usage crosses a threshold or a key becomes invalid.
config.notifyCrit: Critical threshold (percent, usually the rate limit)
